scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing the offline root CA SBD-ROOTCA01 reached only by hand-carried media, the issuing CA SBD-SUBCA01 and publication host SBD-PKI-MGMT01 on VLAN 30, and SBD-DC01 on VLAN 10, which fetches trust data from pki.sbd.test and autoenrolls its domain controller certificate.
scene.completeCaption: The root is back in the vault and offline, the issuing CA publishes only the three planned templates, both domain controllers hold their own certificates, and pki.sbd.test serves current certificates and CRLs at the exact URLs every certificate carries. Enrollment and revocation were proven end to end.

nodes.name: SBD-ROOTCA01
nodes.title: SBD-ROOTCA01 · offline, no network address
nodes.description: The trust anchor: a standalone root CA in a workgroup with no network path, configured in lesson 2. It signs the issuing CA’s certificate at the ceremony and publishes a base CRL every 26 weeks; everything crossing its boundary travels on approved removable media.

nodes.name: SBD-SUBCA01
nodes.title: SBD-SUBCA01 · 10.0.30.20
nodes.description: The enterprise issuing CA, joined to sbd.test on VLAN 30. It creates its request in lesson 3, starts with its signed certificate in lesson 5, writes its CRLs to pki.sbd.test, and publishes only the three templates from lesson 9.

nodes.name: SBD-PKI-MGMT01
nodes.title: SBD-PKI-MGMT01 · 10.0.30.30
nodes.description: A hardened member server on VLAN 30 with two jobs in this course: from lesson 6 it hosts the pki.sbd.test publication site over plain HTTP, and from lesson 8 it is the only seat for certificate template administration. In lesson 10 it is also the pilot that autoenrolls a computer certificate.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: Domain controller from course 1.1, with SBD-DC02 holding the same data by replication: the pki.sbd.test alias from course 1.2, the Group Policy that distributes the root and turns on autoenrollment, and the templates as directory objects. From VLAN 10 it runs the cross-VLAN checks against pki.sbd.test (rule F18), and in lesson 10 both controllers autoenroll their domain controller certificates.

flows.label: Ceremony media · request in, public artifacts out
Issuing CA CRL publication · on schedule
Root certificate and CRL · hand-carried media

chapters.network: Nothing is built yet. SBD-ROOTCA01 is planned with no network connection, and SBD-SUBCA01 and SBD-PKI-MGMT01 are planned on VLAN 30. SBD-DC01 already provides the domain and DNS the issuing CA will depend on.
SBD-ROOTCA01 is now a standalone root CA in the offline vault, drawn in amber with no cable to the core. Nothing travels to or from it yet; SBD-SUBCA01 and SBD-PKI-MGMT01 are still planned.

SBD-SUBCA01 joins VLAN 30 at 10.0.30.20 as an enterprise subordinate CA, waiting for its certificate. Its request file carries only the public key and goes to the media custodian, not across the network.

The request travels to SBD-ROOTCA01 on approved removable media, and the signed subordinate certificate, root certificate, and current root CRL travel back the same way. The amber path is carried by hand; there is no network link to the root.

SBD-SUBCA01 is now a running issuing CA on VLAN 30, and SBD-DC01 carries the Group Policy that delivers the approved root to domain clients. SBD-PKI-MGMT01 is still planned, so the pki.sbd.test URLs have nowhere to answer yet.
SBD-PKI-MGMT01 comes online at 10.0.30.30 and answers for pki.sbd.test on HTTP TCP 80. SBD-DC01, outside VLAN 30, resolves the name and reaches the site across the core under rule F18.

Trust data now reaches pki.sbd.test: the issuing CA writes its CRLs to the site on schedule, and the root’s certificate and CRL arrive by hand-carried media. SBD-DC01 fetches each AIA and CDP URL over HTTP TCP 80.

SBD-PKI-MGMT01 is now also the template administration seat. Template work goes from it to the directory on SBD-DC01, where templates live as objects; the issuing CA’s console stays for CA operations.
Templates are configured from SBD-PKI-MGMT01 and stored in the directory on SBD-DC01, and SBD-SUBCA01 now publishes exactly the three planned templates. Nothing has enrolled yet.

Both domain controllers autoenroll from SBD-SUBCA01 across the core, and the pilot, SBD-PKI-MGMT01, inside VLAN 30. SBD-DC01 validates against pki.sbd.test over HTTP TCP 80, the issuing CA publishes its updated CRL to the site, and the root’s replacement CRLs keep arriving through scheduled, hand-carried ceremonies.
